verdict.rationale: Viam's official CLI documents deleting captured data and managing tags on all data matching a filter, alongside SQL/MQL querying and export, so user-controlled deletion is first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows configurable retention policies or automatic expiry of stored data, so only half the story is covered. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods or auto-expiry, detail on deletion scope and guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
